label: Desk server
description: Owns Desk's record, desk.db, in the node's state (relay-state/process/desk/). Started by the node; reached by jobs.api on the loopback door and by an api packet from a known member (desk/G1.3).

args.name: goalRepo
args.description: The repo the current goal is shared into (goal/G4.21): goalShare.js commits it there on the remote's master and pushes it, on his go, go-all, done, reopen, close and on session.set. Empty: the checkout holding desk.js. The desk never writes into the checkout itself.

args.name: goalPath
args.description: The goal file's path in that repo. With neither goalRepo nor goalPath (a server spawned with {}, as every test suite spawns one) nothing is shared. A desk holding no goal (an agent's node) shares nothing either.
